card.name: Category nouns after all/every, and bilateral
card.fires_on: Nouns like kinds, kind, sort, type or scope that close a phrase such as "of all kinds" or "of every sort". Also "bilateral" after often/usually, and "mL" after a number in a concentration.

modes.label: Kind/sort phrases
modes.description: A noun like kinds, kind, sort or type ends a phrase of variety after all, every or an adjective.
modes.example: Intrigues of all<< kinds>>, especially on the part of the members

modes.label: Bilateral after usually
modes.description: The word bilateral follows often or usually when describing how a condition occurs.
modes.example: Corneal involvement is usually<< bilateral>>. Onset can occur

modes.label: mL in a concentration
modes.description: The unit mL appears after a number in a dose strength.
modes.example: Argatroban Injection 250 mg/2.5<< mL>> (100 mg/mL) must
